name: Heimdall
description: Heimdall is an application dashboard for organising links to your most used websites and web applications. Existing installations can be migrated by copying the complete /config directory and matching the original file ownership with PUID and PGID.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent Heimdall configuration and application data. When migrating an existing installation, copy the complete contents of the original /config volume here while both containers are stopped.

ports.name: HTTP Web UI
ports.description: Heimdall HTTP web interface. Change the host port if port 80 is already used by MOS or another service.

ports.name: HTTPS Web UI
ports.description: Heimdall HTTPS web interface. Change the host port if port 443 is already used by MOS or another service.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID used by the container for files under /config. When migrating existing AppData, set this to the numeric UID that owns the existing files. For example, Unraid commonly uses PUID 99.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID used by the container for files under /config. When migrating existing AppData, set this to the numeric GID that owns the existing files. For example, Unraid commonly uses PGID 100.

variables.name: Allow Internal Requests
variables.description: Allow Heimdall to make requests to private or reserved IP addresses. Enable only if Enhanced Apps need to query services on your LAN. Enabling this increases exposure to SSRF-style requests, so leave false unless required.
